title: Animo JSON
description: Schema for animo.json. Defines Maslow-driven Utility AI personas and kinds. Reference: animo_spec_v0.1.4_EN.md §7, §13. The schema covers types, structure, ranges, and patterns; semantic checks (cross-field, cycle detection, etc.) are performed by Animo.Core.Validator (rules A000–A032).

kinds.description: Type definitions reusable across personas. Optional. (A011a: a Persona without kind_ids must define its own actions.)

personas.description: Individual agent definitions. At least one is required (A001).

snake_case_id.description: snake_case identifier (A002, A003, A018). Allowed: a-z / 0-9 / _. First char must be a letter. No double underscore. No trailing underscore. Max 128 chars.

rate_value.description: Need change rate per second. No hard min/max in spec (negative = grows toward 0; positive = grows toward 100). LLM cheat sheet (§19.3) suggests typical values 0.1 – 10.0.

tier.description: Maslow tier in [1, 5] (A007). 1 = physiological, 2 = safety, 3 = social, 4 = esteem, 5 = self-actualization.

needs_map.description: Need values per Need key. Keys must be snake_case identifiers (free Need names allowed; the 8 standard names — hunger, fatigue, fear, loneliness, confidence, curiosity, idle, frustration — are cataloged in Animo.Const). Values are in [0.0, 100.0] (A005). additionalProperties:false ensures non-string keys are rejected, but patternProperties enforces snake_case on every key.

rates_map.description: Rate values per Need key. Keys must be snake_case identifiers. Values are unbounded numbers (typical range per §19.3).

suppression.description: Tier-level suppression factors. Only tier2..tier5 are allowed (A006). All omitted means no dynamic suppression at the corresponding tier.

influence.description: A directed need-to-need effect (A012, A025). Cycles are detected by the runtime Validator (A025).

action.description: An action definition. As of v0.1.1, 'need' is required (A022) and 'base_score' is removed.

id.description: Action identifier. Free-form non-empty string (A009). PascalCase recommended (e.g. Flee, SearchFood).

commitment.description: Action continuation bonus (v0.1.3+). The 'decay' field was removed in v0.1.3. The whole object may be omitted; default bonus is 0.0.

bonus.description: Score bonus added to the currently chosen action every frame. Does not decay over time. Recommended 5–20. Above 30 raises a Warning (A028).

threshold.description: Two-stage threshold trigger for Germio Bus publishing (v0.1.1). 'reset_threshold' is optional; default = trigger_threshold - 5.0. (A010, A015, A023.)

trigger_threshold.description: Need value at or above which the trigger fires (A010). Range [0.0, 100.0].

reset_threshold.description: Need value at or below which the trigger re-arms. Optional; default trigger_threshold - 5.0. Must be strictly less than trigger_threshold (A023).

trigger.description: Germio Bus event template. Allowed placeholder: {agent_id} (A015). Plain strings without placeholders are also allowed.

binding.description: Germio integration binding. May be omitted (A016 raises Warning when omitted).

on_action_change.description: Bus event template fired on action change. Allowed placeholders: {agent_id}, {behavior} (A014). Default (when omitted): "animo_{agent_id}_{behavior}".

thresholds.description: Two-stage threshold triggers. If you do not need any threshold, omit the 'thresholds' key entirely instead of supplying an empty array.

kind.description: Type definition. Cascades into a Persona via 'kind_ids'. Only 'kind_id' is required; every other field is optional.

persona.description: Individual agent definition. Inherits from each kind in 'kind_ids' in order, then applies its own overrides. (See §8 cascading. A011a: if 'kind_ids' is empty or omitted, the Persona must define at least one Action.)

persona_name.description: Human-readable display name. Optional. No format restriction; UTF-8 free text.

kind_ids.description: Ordered list of kind_ids to compose. Last-wins merge, followed by Persona's own overrides. Each id must exist in 'kinds' (A004; checked by runtime Validator).
